title: Chicago
sideASummary: Player deck back. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Blue Chicago Player card, 41°52'41"N 87°37'47"W. One covered SEARCH box. Not a port. Code P1-03b. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: You may put up to 2 Supply cubes into Chicago from the stockpile. Resolved once, when the box is scratched.

states.summary: Survivors in Chicago say their Pacific haven stopped supply runs. You may put up to 2 Supply cubes into Chicago from the stockpile.

rules: Blue Player card for Chicago. One land search box, labeled SEARCH. No anchor, so it is not a port.
Scratching the box lets you put up to 2 Supply cubes into Chicago from the stockpile.
The result is immediate. It is not a companion, and it has no further effect.
P1-01b puts this card in the Player discard when the package is opened.
notes: Card id 902. Scratched face card id 1009. Printed code P1-03b stays on the scratched face.
No state side A. The player back does not change.
The second Chicago Player card is card 04, which has no search box.
